completion.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features also provides link completions for paths, headings, and reference definitions, but not wiki links.

hover.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features only shows hover previews for image and video links, not Markdown note or heading previews.

definition.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features resolves definitions for headings, inline links, and reference definitions, but not wiki links.

references.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features also finds references to headings, path links, and reference definitions, but does not track wiki links.

documentHighlights.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features implements documentHighlightProvider behind markdown.occurrencesHighlight.enabled (default false); marksman does not implement it.

symbols.note: In VS Code, marksman disables documentSymbolProvider when clientInfo.name is Visual Studio Code so built-in markdown-language-features supplies heading and link-definition symbols instead.

workspaceSymbols.note: In VS Code, marksman disables workspaceSymbolProvider when clientInfo.name is Visual Studio Code so built-in markdown-language-features supplies workspace heading symbols instead.

codeActions.note: Marksman offers Table of Contents and Create missing file actions; VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features offers Organize link definitions, Extract link to definition, and link-definition quick fixes.

rename.note: VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features also renames headings, link definitions, and path links across the workspace, but not wiki links.

foldingRanges.note: Marksman does not implement textDocument/foldingRange; in VS Code this comes from built-in markdown-language-features.

selectionRanges.note: Marksman does not implement textDocument/selectionRange; in VS Code this comes from built-in markdown-language-features.

semanticTokens.note: Provided by marksman for wiki links, reference link labels, and tags; VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features does not offer semantic tokens.

diagnostics.note: Marksman publishes broken-link diagnostics by default; VS Code's built-in markdown-language-features offers pull diagnostics behind markdown.validate.enabled (default false).
